The transfer function has a conditional check that requires either the sender 'from' to not be in a chosen list or the recipient 'to' to be in the '_feeWhiteList'.
Since the owner can modify the '_feeWhiteList', they can effectively control who can receive tokens, thus limiting the ability of ordinary users to trade freely.
